name: unpackerr (selfhosters)
description:
Unpackerr extracts completed downloads for Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, Readarr, and folder watches. 

After install, open the WebUI and add your Starr apps there. 
Do not put URLs or API keys in environment variables unless you want those fields locked. 

Mount Downloads Location with the same container path your Starr apps use (/data or /downloads). 
Appdata /config holds unpackerr.conf. Extra Parameters --user 99:100 must match Sonarr/Radarr. 
The golift image does not use PUID/PGID. Docs: https://unpackerr.zip/docs/install/unraid

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Container Path: /config - unpackerr.conf, logs if you set them here, and UI saves.

paths.name: Downloads Location
paths.description: Must match the Starr app download mount. If Starr apps use /data, change this container path to /data.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Container Port: 5656 - Unpackerr web UI and HTTP API.

author: selfhosters
